author: gaxanh
content:
This addresses an issue raised here. The gas_left > 20000 threshold is applied to maintain compatibility with Osaka within the same state transition. The 2,100 gas cost is excluded because an attacker can prepay it through the access list. This restriction applies only during state creation and is limited to the execution direction
https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8037-state-creation-gas-cost-increase/25694/28

author: draganrakita
content: I am still confused to figure out the problem, is the problem with setting to low of gas limit for subcall?

author: gaxanh
content: The current call frame, rather than a child call frame, requests a limited amount of gas. Under Osaka, this amount is insufficient to qualify for creating a new slot. Amsterdam, however, lowers the threshold from 20,000 to 10,100, while increasing the absolute cost (97,920 gas for state access). Most of this cost can be funded independently of the current call frame’s gas budget.
